maya: quick sync: we need a low-risk pattern to promote eu replica -> primary w/o user-visible reorders. ideas?
ryan: two levers: server-side idempotency export OR client-side consistency token. each has tradeoffs.
lucy: prefer token for reads (consistency-token returned on write) + short sticky routing for first-2h. tokens avoid moving state but require SDK bump.
maya: tokens good for reads but don't help dedupe during replay. we still need dedupe metadata replication for safety. can we keep it bounded?
ryan: yes. export compacted map (idempotency_key_hash -> last_seq) with tenant TTL 48h and per-tenant size cap. mark snapshot with watermark.
infra-bot: RUNBOOK NOTE: exporter must abort if any tenant export_count > 5M or export_lag > 3m. Link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/promote-guide
lucy: exporter implementation: sidecar writes compacted diffs into control-plane topic; compaction keyed by idempotency hash, last-wins. also HMAC keys for privacy.
maya: operator checklist (proposal): fence old primary -> snapshot export complete & validator sample pass -> flip pointer -> enable writes -> monitor 60m. rollback path included.
ryan: add metrics: promote_replayed_writes, export_lag_ms, token_validation_failures. alert on spikes.
lucy: comms: advise customers to use idempotency-key + SDK with tokens for critical flows; note small window of duplicate risk if tenant is very hot and export truncated.
maya: ok action items: lucy = exporter PR, ryan = token spec + SDK note, ops = add runbook abort thresholds. dry-run next Tue.
infra-bot: Promotion dry-run scheduled: DR-2024-11-12-02.
